# Bosch Rexroth – your partner for
# hydraulics and automation

 

Welcome to Bosch Rexroth. We are here to support you at every stage of your journey, offering
cutting-edge automation solutions, software, and services to help you to drive your business
efficient and powerful, more digital and sustainable.

Explore our innovative drive and control technology, our company and our employees. Enjoy our
stories and interviews about the latest trends in factory automation, industrial hydraulics, mobile
hydraulics and electronics.

Innovative technology makes a difference to the world. But it´s not about the technology, it´s about
choosing to use it. Learn more about Bosch Rexroths Focus Topics - Digital Transformation,
Sustainability, People.

[A person, seen from behind, is looking at a large digital globe displaying interconnected points
and glowing lines.]

Digital Transformation - Embracing the Power of Software

Experience the future of digitalization with Bosch Rexroth. From dynamic movement to software-driven
automation: our solutions are designed to increase productivity and save resources. Discover our
digital solutions at all levels: from the field, up to cloud-based analytics using artificial
intelligence.

## Step Into the World of Hydraulics

A big welcome to our world of hydraulics.

Hydraulics is the study of the flow behavior of fluids when used for transmitting signals, forces,
and power. For us, this means that we are always working with the pressure of the oil flow. Not only
from a physical perspective, but also in terms of new ideas and adapting to the wishes of our
customers. We direct our ideas towards the needs of the market.

[About us - Welcome to Bucher Hydraulics!][76]

## Job and Career Opportunities at Bucher Hydraulics

At Bucher Hydraulics, we live a culture that promotes open communication, personal development, and
intensive teamwork across the board. This expertise is only one part of our success, however. The
above-average commitment, the high levels of dedication and the initiative of our people form an
immense potential on which to draw.

## Step Into the World of Hydraulics

A big welcome to our world of hydraulics.

Hydraulics is the study of the flow behavior of fluids when used for transmitting signals, forces,
and power. For us, this means that we are always working with the pressure of the oil flow. Not only
from a physical perspective, but also in terms of new ideas and adapting to the wishes of our
customers. We direct our ideas towards the needs of the market.

[About us - Welcome to Bucher Hydraulics!][76]

## Job and Career Opportunities at Bucher Hydraulics

At Bucher Hydraulics, we live a culture that promotes open communication, personal development, and
intensive teamwork across the board. This expertise is only one part of our success, however. The
above-average commitment, the high levels of dedication and the initiative of our people form an
immense potential on which to draw.

## We engineer a better future

We engineer solutions that increase machine productivity, reduce emissions, lower energy
consumption, and enable electrification.

With sustainability at the core of our business, we drive competitiveness for Danfoss and our
customers.

The technologies and solutions needed to address global challenges already exist, thanks to our
dedicated Danfoss teams worldwide.

[ Get to know us ][7]

## How to efficiently scale data centers

It’s time for a paradigm shift.
 
Industry experts come together to share how to enable rapid, energy-efficient data center growth in
this new episode of Decarbonization Explained.

## Our business segments

[
[Power Solutions]
][13]
Danfoss Power Solutions

Full solutions across mobile and industrial hydraulics, fluid conveyance and data center
applications, electrification, and software.

Show more Show less

[Danfoss Climate Solutions-energy efficient solutions for buildings]
][14]
Danfoss Climate Solutions

Energy-efficient heating and cooling solutions for industrial applications, buildings,
infrastructure, data centers and the cold chain.

Show more Show less

[Danfoss Power Electronics and Drives]

Danfoss Power Electronics and Drives

Power semiconductor modules, variable speed  drives, and power conversion solutions engineered to
enable electrification and enhance energy efficiency and productivity across industries

# Control Focused, Technology Driven

# Innovative Solutions for High-Performance Customers

Husco is a privately-owned company specializing in hydraulic and electro-mechanical control systems.
We have over 80 years of experience designing and manufacturing components for Automotive and
Off-Highway equipment. Our collaborative customer relationships are driven by three essential
values: intelligent risk-taking, high performance, and practical innovation.



## Off-Highway

Husco’s Off-Highway team specializes in customized hydraulic solutions for agricultural,
construction, material handling, and commercial equipment.

[Learn More][22]



## Automotive

Husco’s Automotive team designs and manufactures innovative electro-hydraulic and electro-mechanical
components that maximize fuel efficiency, driving performance and vehicle safety.

[Learn More][23]

## Husco Careers

A career at Husco is not just a job — it’s an entrepreneurial experience that offers incredible
opportunities for growth and creativity. Across all areas of the company, our team members are
smart, hardworking, and highly motivated to succeed.

[View Opportunities][24]

ENGLISH

# Control Focused, Technology Driven

# Innovative Solutions for High-Performance Customers

Husco is a privately-owned company specializing in hydraulic and electro-mechanical control systems.
We have over 80 years of experience designing and manufacturing components for Automotive and
Off-Highway equipment. Our collaborative customer relationships are driven by three essential
values: intelligent risk-taking, high performance, and practical innovation.



## Off-Highway

Husco’s Off-Highway team specializes in customized hydraulic solutions for agricultural,
construction, material handling, and commercial equipment.

[Learn More][22]



## Automotive

Husco’s Automotive team designs and manufactures innovative electro-hydraulic and electro-mechanical
components that maximize fuel efficiency, driving performance and vehicle safety.

[Learn More][23]

## Husco Careers

A career at Husco is not just a job — it’s an entrepreneurial experience that offers incredible
opportunities for growth and creativity. Across all areas of the company, our team members are
smart, hardworking, and highly motivated to succeed.

[View Opportunities][24]

## Our Industry Solutions

[Stationary industries, alternative]

### Industrial Applications

Whether it’s hydrogen technologies, geothermal energy or machine tools – HYDAC is active worldwide
in all kinds of industrial applications. Here you will find an overview of our products and services
in a wide range of sectors of industry, and can access precious information at the click of a
button. 

[**More about Industrial Applications**][171]

[Mobile industries]

### Mobile Applications

From agricultural and forestry machinery through construction machinery to municipal machinery as
well as lifting & material handling equipment – our systems and components are tailored to your
specific machine types. Discover for yourself how HYDAC can best support you in optimising your
mobile working machine.

[**More about Mobile Solutions**][172]

## Topics & Trends

### What’s driving the industry

Be it industrial applications or the mobile sector - read all about the latest topics and trends in
our Topics & News section.

## HYDAC on Tap Podcast Series

The HYDAC On Tap podcast series explores current challenges facing manufacturers, OEMs, and end
users in both the industrial and mobile markets and introduces HYDAC's innovative solutions to help
solve them. Tapping into more than 60 years of expertise, HYDAC On Tap invites experts from HYDAC on
a variety of topics, from electrification, automation, filtration, efficient hydraulics and what
customers can expect in new and emerging markets. Subscribe to this podcast to receive alerts when
new content drops or peruse our library to find a wide variety of topics to meets your needs!

[Learn more][183]

## Our Industry Solutions

### Industrial Applications

Whether it’s hydrogen technologies, geothermal energy or machine tools – HYDAC is active worldwide
in all kinds of industrial applications. Here you will find an overview of our products and services
in a wide range of sectors of industry, and can access precious information at the click of a
button.

[Mobile industries]

### Mobile Applications

From agricultural and forestry machinery through construction machinery to municipal machinery as
well as lifting & material handling equipment – our systems and components are tailored to your
specific machine types. Discover for yourself how HYDAC can best support you in optimising your
mobile working machine.

[**More about Mobile Solutions**][172]

## HYDAC on Tap Podcast Series

The HYDAC On Tap podcast series explores current challenges facing manufacturers, OEMs, and end
users in both the industrial and mobile markets and introduces HYDAC's innovative solutions to help
solve them. Tapping into more than 60 years of expertise, HYDAC On Tap invites experts from HYDAC on
a variety of topics, from electrification, automation, filtration, efficient hydraulics and what
customers can expect in new and emerging markets. Subscribe to this podcast to receive alerts when
new content drops or peruse our library to find a wide variety of topics to meets your needs!

## This year marks Moog’s 75th anniversary, reflecting decades of resilience and ingenuity.

Founded in 1951 by Bill Moog with a bold vision to empower people and solve tough problems through
trust and innovation, our company grew from a small airplane hangar in East Aurora into a global
leader in aerospace, defense, industrial automation, and medical technology. Through change and
challenge, Moog has remained committed to innovation and culture. Today, we continue to shape the
way our world moves while building a sustainable business for generations to come.

## Electrification, Innovation Made Easy for Efficient & Sustainable Future

Electrification is transforming the off-highway industry, blending innovation with simplicity.
Poclain’s advanced electrohydraulic and full-electric solutions accelerate time-to-market while
maximizing ROI. With a technology-agnostic approach, we integrate cutting-edge full-electric drives
and proven hydraulic expertise to deliver high-performance, sustainable solutions. From wheel
loaders to autonomous agricultural machines, our electrification technologies are shaping a greener,
more efficient future.

## Become a Crown Insider for exclusive product updates.

[Banner Background][Banner Background]

## BEHIND THE CROWN

The legacy of family, the promise of quality.
* 1938Fayette D. “Fate” Leebern founds Columbus Wine Company Distributors in Columbus, Georgia. The
  business is credited with unloading the first legal carload of liquor in Georgia after the end of
  Prohibition in 1933.
* 1949Columbus Wine Company Distributors is incorporated in Muscogee County, Georgia, at which time
  the name is changed to Georgia Crown Distributing Co. The company’s new identity sheds the
  regionality of its previous name, positioning itself as a statewide operation.
* 1980Alabama Crown Distributing Co. is established, as Georgia Crown expands into the state of
  Alabama, establishing a warehouse and distribution network in Dothan, Alabama. Initially, the
  company distributed only non-alcoholic beverages and mixers.
* 1980Alabama Crown expands into the Mobile market, with the acquisition of the San Pedro Wine
  Company. Expansion into the Montgomery market is also established around this time.
* 1981The Birmingham market is opened for distribution with the acquisition of Sterling/Pabst
  Distributing.
* 1982A new warehouse is built in Huntsville, Alabama, serving the northern portion of the state.
  Previously serviced out of the Birmingham facility, the Huntsville warehouse localized
  distribution for the growing market.
* 1990Alabama Crown’s Dothan operation is consolidated into the Montgomery facility.
* 2002In efforts to further centralize inventory management, the Huntsville location is closed and
  consolidated into the Birmingham facility.
* 2014A new, state-of-the-art central facility for Alabama Crown Distributing Co. is opened in
  Alabaster, Alabama, in the Birmingham metro area. The existing Birmingham, Mobile, and Montgomery
  warehouses are closed and centralized in the Alabaster location, providing efficient inventory
  management, operations, and logistics under one roof.
* 201855,000 square feet of additional warehouse space is added to the Alabaster central facility,
  signaling the company’s rapid growth and need for additional inventory to serve Alabama’s retail
  tier.
* 2023Expanding its specialty offerings, Alabama Crown secures the rights to distribute Nesquik milk
  products and Essentia water in early 2023.
* 2024Alabama Crown’s already impressive book of wine and beer brands grows significantly with the
  purchase of distribution rights for a majority of the wine and craft beer brands of International
  Wines, Inc.

[Banner Background][Banner Background]

## BEHIND THE CROWN

The legacy of family, the promise of quality.
* 1938Fayette D. “Fate” Leebern founds Columbus Wine Company Distributors in Columbus, Georgia. The
  business is credited with unloading the first legal carload of liquor in Georgia after the end of
  Prohibition in 1933.
* 1949Columbus Wine Company Distributors is incorporated in Muscogee County, Georgia, at which time
  the name is changed to Georgia Crown Distributing Co. The company’s new identity sheds the
  regionality of its previous name, positioning itself as a statewide operation.
* 1980Alabama Crown Distributing Co. is established, as Georgia Crown expands into the state of
  Alabama, establishing a warehouse and distribution network in Dothan, Alabama. Initially, the
  company distributed only non-alcoholic beverages and mixers.
* 1980Alabama Crown expands into the Mobile market, with the acquisition of the San Pedro Wine
  Company. Expansion into the Montgomery market is also established around this time.
* 1981The Birmingham market is opened for distribution with the acquisition of Sterling/Pabst
  Distributing.
* 1982A new warehouse is built in Huntsville, Alabama, serving the northern portion of the state.
  Previously serviced out of the Birmingham facility, the Huntsville warehouse localized
  distribution for the growing market.
* 1990Alabama Crown’s Dothan operation is consolidated into the Montgomery facility.
* 2002In efforts to further centralize inventory management, the Huntsville location is closed and
  consolidated into the Birmingham facility.
* 2014A new, state-of-the-art central facility for Alabama Crown Distributing Co. is opened in
  Alabaster, Alabama, in the Birmingham metro area. The existing Birmingham, Mobile, and Montgomery
  warehouses are closed and centralized in the Alabaster location, providing efficient inventory
  management, operations, and logistics under one roof.
* 201855,000 square feet of additional warehouse space is added to the Alabaster central facility,
  signaling the company’s rapid growth and need for additional inventory to serve Alabama’s retail
  tier.
* 2023Expanding its specialty offerings, Alabama Crown secures the rights to distribute Nesquik milk
  products and Essentia water in early 2023.
* 2024Alabama Crown’s already impressive book of wine and beer brands grows significantly with the
  purchase of distribution rights for a majority of the wine and craft beer brands of International
  Wines, Inc.

compressor or replacement parts for your chiller system, we have you covered.Competitive and Highest

ensure that your chiller system operates at its best.Innovative Air-Conditioning Products and

need a new air-conditioning system installed or want to upgrade your existing one, we have the

Energy Storage Solutions

## Core Products: Hydraulic Accumulators

[ view more ][55]

Explore our range of **precision-engineered accumulators**. Each type is designed for specific
performance characteristics to meet your exact requirements for energy storage, shock absorption,
and pulsation damping.

Compact, fast-responding, and reliable in high-pressure use with strong sealing. Easy to maintain,
durable, and ideal for energy storage, shock absorption, and leak compensation in industrial
hydraulic systems.
[ view more ][56]

### Bladder Accumulator

high-capacity design handles high pressures and large flows with long service life. Stable energy
storage for heavy-duty scenarios like hydraulic presses.
[ view more ][57]

### Piston Accumulator

Small, sensitive, and excellent sealing. Perfect for low-pressure and high-pressure, small-capacity
needs—precise energy control and vibration reduction for precision equipment and light industry. ike
construction machinery.
[ view more ][58]

### Diaphragm Accumulator

Integrated, customizable accumulator stations for centralized energy storage and pressure
management. Compact design, easy installation, and stable performance—ideal for large-scale
hydraulic systems in industrial applications.

safety in demanding conditions.

[How to Match a PTO Gearbox to a Tractor Hydraulic Pump][104]
[A tractor PTO commonly operates at 540 rpm, while many hydraulic gear pumps require a higher shaft
speed to produce the intended flow. A PTO gearbox speed increaser connects the tractor power
take-off to the hydraulic pump and raises the rotational speed to a more suitable operating
range.][105]

[When Should You Use a 0.75L Diaphragm Accumulator?][108]
[0.75L diaphragm accumulator is commonly selected for compact hydraulic systems that need short-term
energy storage, pressure stabilization or protection against sudden pressure changes. It is not
intended to replace the hydraulic pump. Instead, it stores a limited quantity of pressurized fluid
and releases it when system pressure falls or flow demand rises.][109]

[How Does an RD5100 Manual Directional Control Valve Support Compact Hydraulic Systems?][112]
[RD5100 Manual Directional Control Valve is designed for hydraulic equipment that requires direct,
dependable control of oil flow to a cylinder or hydraulic motor. By moving the manual operating
lever, the operator can direct pressurized hydraulic oil to extend, retract, lift, lower, tilt, or
operate another hydraulic function.][113]

Can you provide OEM service?

How do you solve when quality problems occurred?

How about your quality control?

and quality standard agreed by both party. Always a pre-production sample before mass production;

How to receive a price quotation in the shortest time?

soon.

## Hergün Gelişen Tecrübesiyle Devleşen MARKA

ERDEM SOĞUTMA, soğutma sektöründe satış ve sonrası alanındaki deneyimi ile bilgiye dayalı yüksek
teknoloji çözümleri sunan, sürekli kendini geliştiren, yenilikleri takip eden, performanslı
altyapıya sahip ekibiyle fark oluşturarak tek adres olmaktadır.

Vizyon ve Sürdürülebilirlik

Erdem Soğutma; eğitim ve bilginin en üst seviyede paylaşımına verdiği önem paralelinde, müşteri
memnuniyetine vermiş olduğu önemin sürekliliğinin sağlanmasını ve en üst düzeye çıkartılması
çerçevesinde hizmetlerini sürdürmektedir.

Misyonumuz

Çevreye ve insana duyarlı, yaratıcı ve sürdürülebilir teknolojiyi benimseyen ESS’nin temel ilkesi;
soğutma sektörünün birçok alanında üstün kaliteli ürünler sunarak, bu alanlarda ihracat oranını
artırmak, partnerlerinin beklentilerini en üst seviyede karşılamak ve bu sektöre katkıda
bulunmaktır.

Sürdürülebilirlik Hedefler

çerçevesinde hizmetlerini sürdürmektedir.

## Hoşgeldiniz

* Deneyimli ve sertifikalı uzman kadro
* Verimli iş planlama yapısı
* Projelerde sürekli ilerleme
* Teknik altyapı

ESS Erdem Soğutma Sistemleri her geçen gün üretim kapasitesi ile beraber ürün ve model çeşitliliği
arttırmaktadır. 

[ Hakkımızda ][71]

## 2022 Yılı Özel Kataloğumuz

[ Kataloğu İndir ][72]
Soğutmanın Kalbinde

## Hergün Gelişen Tecrübesiyle Devleşen MARKA

ERDEM SOĞUTMA, soğutma sektöründe satış ve sonrası alanındaki deneyimi ile bilgiye dayalı yüksek
teknoloji çözümleri sunan, sürekli kendini geliştiren, yenilikleri takip eden, performanslı
altyapıya sahip ekibiyle fark oluşturarak tek adres olmaktadır.

Vizyon ve Sürdürülebilirlik

Erdem Soğutma; eğitim ve bilginin en üst seviyede paylaşımına verdiği önem paralelinde, müşteri
memnuniyetine vermiş olduğu önemin sürekliliğinin sağlanmasını ve en üst düzeye çıkartılması
çerçevesinde hizmetlerini sürdürmektedir.

Misyonumuz

Çevreye ve insana duyarlı, yaratıcı ve sürdürülebilir teknolojiyi benimseyen ESS’nin temel ilkesi;
soğutma sektörünün birçok alanında üstün kaliteli ürünler sunarak, bu alanlarda ihracat oranını
artırmak, partnerlerinin beklentilerini en üst seviyede karşılamak ve bu sektöre katkıda
bulunmaktır.

Sürdürülebilirlik Hedefler

Çevresel etkilerimizi azaltmak.

Farklılık etkinlikleri ve eğitimler ile sürdürülebilirlik konusu ve bunun önemi hakkında
farkındalığın arttırılması konusunda çalışmak.

Sürdürülebilirlik konusunda uluslararası standartlara ve inisiyatife üye olmak ve çalışmalara katkı
sağlamak için çaba göstermek.

# About Fluid Energy Controls, Inc.

Fluid Energy Controls, Inc. since 1995, is an Accumulator manufacturer and distributor of fluid
power products such as pumps, motors, valves, filters, cylinders, accumulators and other hydraulic
components.
Fluid Energy Control Inc. started out as a custom accumulator manufacturer and over the years has
expanded into the provider of a complete range of accumulators including bladder accumulators,
diaphragm accumulators, piston accumulators, pulsation dampners, surge dampners, gas bottles, flex
breathers and accessories.
[ About Company ][36]

## Bladder Accumulator - ASME

[Bladder Accumulator]
* ASME coded and stamped per Section VIII, Div. I
* Sizes up to 40 Gallons
* Pressure up to 6,600 psi
* Fluid Port: NPT, SAE, Code 61, 62 SAE Split flange
* Bladder: Buna N, Viton, EPR, Hydrin, Low Temp
* Shell: Carbon Stell, Stainless Steel, Epoxy Coated
* Other material & certifications available on [Request][37]
[Bladder Accumulator - ASME]

## Bladder Accumulator - CE/PED

[Bladder Accumulator - CE]
* CE/PED Certified
* Sizes up to 57 Liters
* Pressure up to 350 bar
* Fluid Port: Metric, BSP
* Bladder: Buna N, Viton, EPR, Hydrin, Low Temp
* Shell: Carbon Stell, Stainless Steel, Epoxy Coated
* Other material & certifications available on [Request][38]
[Bladder Accumulator- PED]

## Custom Accumulators

[Custom Accumulator]
* ASME coded and stamped per Section VIII, Div. I
* Sizes up to 120 Gallons
* Pressure up to 500 psi
* Fluid Port: ANSI RF flange
* Bladder: Buna N, Viton, EPR, Hydrin, Low Temp
* Shell: Carbon Stell, Stainless Steel, Epoxy Coated
* Other material & certifications available on [Request][39]
[Custom Accumulator]

* Pressure up to 275 psi
* Fluid Port: ANSI RF flange
* Bladder: Buna N, Viton, EPR, Hydrin, Low Temp
* Shell: Carbon Stell, Stainless Steel, Epoxy Coated

* Other material & certifications available on [Request][40]

* Bladder: Buna N, Viton, EPR, Hydrin, Low Temp

# See what your competitors
# will do next.

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

Book a Demo

[From digital exhaust to predictions]

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.
* Digital exhaust
  LinkedIn activity
  Job descriptions
  API documentation
  Web & copy changes
  Reddit threads
  + 19 more source types
  CaptureWe monitor the unintentional data trails companies leave behind — job descriptions
  revealing technical debt, API documentation exposing new features, employee posts leaking project
  updates and more. Intelligence they never meant to share.
  Signals
  Hiring
  Field sales push
  12 AE roles, 3 metros
  Product
  New API surface
  Endpoints + docs added
  SynthesizeA single job post or pricing page tweak is noise. Hundreds, woven together, become
  patterns. We connect signals across sources — hiring spikes, doc changes, ad shifts, partnership
  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.
  Predictions
  Forecast
  Mid-market
  enterprise launch
  Hiring, product, and brand signals align one direction.
  Within 60 days
  High confidence
  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,
  acquisitions, organizational pivots — each with a time horizon and confidence score. You see the
  move before it's made, not after the press release.
Testimonials

  "A competitor quietly sunsetted a feature — no announcement, no changelog, no blog post. The only

The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

into a single forecast you can act on.
